title: Pricing Policies
modules: Legal And Regulatory Issues In Pricing
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the characteristics of market organization that are likely to affect a firm's behavior and performance."
Market structure is defined as the characteristics of market organization that are likely to affect a firm's behavior and performance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the stage of a product life cycle when the sales curve peaks and starts to decline as profits continue to fall."
The maturity is the stage of a product life cycle when the sales curve peaks and starts to decline as profits continue to fall.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a geographic pricing policy that includes the price at the factory plus freight charges from the base point nearest to the buyer."
Base-point pricing is a geographic pricing policy that includes the price at the factory plus freight charges from the base point nearest to the buyer.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the approach used to set the price of a product or service."
A pricing strategy is the approach used to set the price of a product or service.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an arrangement in which a supplier, or franchiser, grants a dealer or franchisee, the right to sell products in exchange for some consideration (Pride & Ferrell, 2010)."
Franchising is an arrangement in which a supplier, or franchiser, grants a dealer or franchisee, the right to sell products in exchange for some consideration (Pride & Ferrell, 2010).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the corner- stone for establishing a business."
Profit is the corner- stone for establishing a business.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a high price intended to "skim the cream off the market"."
A Skimming price is a high price intended to "skim the cream off the market".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to keep time around the world and thus can be standardization."
Watches are used to keep time around the world and thus can be standardization.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a policy of trial and error, balancing losses and gains in fixing the price."
Probe pricing is a policy of trial and error, balancing losses and gains in fixing the price.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the decision and actions associated with establishing pricing objectives and policies and the determination of product price."
The Price variable is concerned with the decision and actions associated with establishing pricing objectives and policies and the determination of product price.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered unethical, and in some countries illegal as well."
Bait and switch is considered unethical, and in some countries illegal as well.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is known as Full Cost Pricing."
The commonest form is known as Full Cost Pricing.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the strategies that marketers adopt for a new product pricing."
Price skimming is one of the strategies that marketers adopt for a new product pricing.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the only consideration of price."
Cost is the only consideration of price.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the additional cost for producing additional unit of output."
Marginal cost is the additional cost for producing additional unit of output.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as a value expressed in monetary medium of exchange."
Price in marketing is defined as a value expressed in monetary medium of exchange.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the end result of a long process of consumer decision making."
Purchase behaviour is the end result of a long process of consumer decision making.

Base- point pricing
Base- point pricing is a geographic pricing policy that includes the price at the factory plus freight charges from the base point nearest to the buyer.

growth
The growth is the stage of a product's life cycle when sales rise rapidly and profits reach a peak and then start to decline.
______ is the market price less a small discount to reflect the lack of sales effort and other expenses.
Market based cost
Market based cost is the market price less a small discount to reflect the lack of sales effort and other expenses.
______ is a physical entity you see and touch.
good
A good is a physical entity you see and touch.
______ is the most common approach in practice.
Cost-oriented pricing
Cost-oriented pricing is the most common approach in practice.

Falling real income
Falling real income means that only lesser quantities of goods and services will be demanded unless money income is increased by the same or greater proportion of the increase in prices.

Prestige pricing
Prestige pricing is used especially when buyers associate a higher pricewith higher quality.
______ are used by organizations that have competitive pricing objectives.
Competitive pricing strategies
Competitive pricing strategies are used by organizations that have competitive pricing objectives.

foreign distributor
A foreign distributor is a foreign firm that has exclusive rights to carry out distribution for a manufacturer in a foreign country or specific area.

NNPC
NNPC is a typical organization that has this policy.
______ is a marketing decision variable employed by organizations to realize their objectives.
Cost Price basically
Cost Price basically is a marketing decision variable employed by organizations to realize their objectives.
______ is the application of human and mechanical efforts to people or objects to provide intangible benefits to consumers.
service
A service is the application of human and mechanical efforts to people or objects to provide intangible benefits to consumers.
______ is the only marketing decision variable that has an inverse relationship with demand.
Price
Price is the only marketing decision variable that has an inverse relationship with demand.
______ is a corollary to the big-car syndrome.
left-hand drive syndrome
The left-hand drive syndrome is a corollary to the big-car syndrome.
______ is a logical and natural choice for costly industrial products.
direct channel
The direct channel is a logical and natural choice for costly industrial products.
